parts.prompt:
Which statement is always true?

A. Every continuous function is differentiable.
B. A function with a derivative of 0 at x=a has a local extremum there.
C. A function can be differentiable where it is discontinuous.
D. If a function is differentiable at x=a, then it is continuous there.
